policy.green: No forklift currently overlaps the red zone and none is projected to enter within three seconds.
policy.amber: A moving forklift is projected from consecutive camera frames to enter the red zone within three seconds.
policy.red: Any part of any forklift overlaps the red-zone image mask.

verdict: The bounded EVK transport returned the exact expected GREEN, AMBER, and RED JSON signals on real Isaac Sim frames. The live Play-controlled loop also applied an EVK RED response to the stack light. This is experimental demo evidence, not a certified safety result.
